_HOW_TO: PUT any website link in a slot's 'url'. Three kinds work:
1. Bare domain:  https://pngtree.com            -> the domain is searched via Bing 'your-query site:pngtree.com' AND the page is fetched directly.
2. Category page: https://pngtree.com/free-animals-png/fish -> fetched AS-IS (do not add ?s= yourself).
3. Template:     https://mysite.com/search?q={query} -> {query} is replaced by the search word. If you leave {query} out of a BARE domain, ?s=<word> is appended as before.
'type': 'image' for picture sites, 'gif' for GIF sites. 'enabled': false switches a slot off without deleting it.
Save, restart the scraper, then open /my-links in the browser to check. A dead slot never breaks a search - it is skipped and logged.
v2.4 ALSO searches Bing Images, Flickr, Wikimedia, Wikipedia and Openclipart for every query - you get real content images even with zero slots filled.
